instrument_note: Reference chart and execution tape are separate series; reference levels are not direct execution-order prices without basis adjustment.

edge_context.prior_state: Price approached dVAL from below with CVD/OI recovery after a major long-liquidation flush.
edge_context.trigger_observed: Price failed to accept above dVAL and rolled back below the value boundary.
edge_context.confirmation_observed: CVD stopped improving and rolled slightly lower as price fell; OI also began to contract, indicating the bounce leverage was being unwound after rejection.

interpretation: This frame validates the path logic of the candidate short setup in real time: the actionable information was the failed repair at dVAL, not the later low. By the time price was near ~77.1k reference / ~77.0k execution, OI was already falling and long liquidations had increased, so the continuation was becoming deleveraging and the risk/reward of chasing a fresh short deteriorated.

ideal_execution_lesson.preferred_entry_zone: At or just after the failed dVAL reclaim/rejection around the then-active ~77.31-77.43k reference value boundary, after confirmation that price could not hold above.
ideal_execution_lesson.confirmation: CVD stalls/turns down and price forms rejection/lower high; OI remains elevated initially or starts unwinding only after the rejection has trapped the rebound.
ideal_execution_lesson.do_not_chase: Do not initiate a late short after the move extends lower while OI is already collapsing and long liquidations are expanding.
ideal_execution_lesson.next_chance: Wait for another bounce into broken dVAL / local resistance and reject again, or for a clean continuation break where price/CVD fall while OI is flat/up rather than collapsing.

lesson: A failed structural reclaim can be the edge trigger even if the subsequent drop is dominated by deleveraging. Entry quality is highest at the failed repair; once OI starts collapsing and long liquidations expand, the market has already moved from directional edge into forced unwind and late shorts become lower quality.
